title: GameForge game configuration
description: Describes a game project: where its entry point lives, how it should be built and what it needs at runtime.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

id.description: Stable identifier, lowercase kebab-case. Used as the build folder name and the portal's game id.

name.description: Human-readable title shown in the runtime and the portal.

version.description: Semantic version of the game itself.

engine.description: Engine version range this game was written against.

entry.description: Module exporting the game (a `setup(engine)` function). Relative to the project root.

type.description: Projection. Only 2d is implemented; 3d arrives with the WebGL2 work.

pixelArt.description: Disable image smoothing for crisp scaled sprites.

scenes.description: Scene files to copy into the build output.

assets.description: Glob patterns (relative to the project root) of files to copy and hash into the build.

scripts.description: Project-local scripts. Advisory only; the CLI provides dev/build.
